name: Finding the fault
note: The Class XI classroom family for the investigate structure: something that should work and does not, with four or five candidate causes and tests of different cost (ALTERNATE_WORLD.md: 'Four possible causes; you have time to test two'). Computing, practical science and repair reach it. The method thresholds are chosen: Practical Repair starts at 0 and is seeded additively by technical_aptitude and practical_experience at 10, 25, 45 or 70 XP by rank, so any rank in either trait halves the search, rank 2 in one trait (or rank 1 in both) reads a meter, and rank 3 (or rank 2 with rank 1) swaps in a known-good part.
